description: This PHP file defines the base class 'SugarView' which is part of SuiteCRM/SugarCRM's MVC framework. It provides core functionality for rendering views, including dependency loading, header/footer rendering, error handling, and module menu management. It is a foundational component for various types of views within the application.

classes.name: SugarView
classes.description: A base class providing core view rendering functionalities in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM MVC architecture. It manages header/footer display, error handling, JavaScript inclusion, module menus, breadcrumbs, and activity tracking.
